{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build and publish nuget packages for bindings

on:
    push:
        branches:
        - master
        paths:
        - "Bindings/**/*.*"
        - "build.fsx"
        - ".github/workflows/Build and publish nuget package for bindings.yml"

jobs:
  build-and-push-nuget-packages-for-bindings:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write  # required for NuGet.org trusted publishing (OIDC)

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5

    - name: Setup .NET Core
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
      with:
        dotnet-version: 10.0.x

    - name: Cache NuGet packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.nuget/packages
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-${{ hashFiles('**/*.fsproj', '**/*.csproj', '**/packages.lock.json', 'build.fsx') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-

    - name: NuGet login (OIDC -> short-lived API key)
      id: nuget-login
      uses: NuGet/login@v1
      with:
        # nuget.org profile name (the owner of the trusted publishing policy)
        user: slaveoftime

    - name: Run build.fsx
      env:
        NUGET_API_KEY: ${{ steps.nuget-login.outputs.NUGET_API_KEY }}
      run: dotnet fsi build.fsx -- -p packages --bindings",
  "rationale": "Applied P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads): added an actions/cache@v4 step for ~/.nuget/packages, keyed on the .NET/F# project files, packages.lock.json, and build.fsx, placed after SDK setup and before the build. All original steps (checkout, setup-dotnet, NuGet OIDC login, build.fsx) and permissions (contents: read, id-token: write) are preserved, so build/publish coverage and required checks are unchanged. Supported by experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9 (measured CI workflow on fork; dependency cache added, ~6% elapsed savings). No permissions weakened, no secrets, publishing/deployment operations, or new network access added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
